title: Vapouriz 50/50 Cherry 10ml
description: Vapouriz 50/50's Cherry delivers a bold and juicy vape with the deep, slightly tart sweetness of ripe red Cherries. The flavour is rich without being overpowering, capturing the essence of classic Cherry blends with a satisfying, full-bodied finish. Formulated at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping and performs best in pod kits, starter vape pens and other low-powered devices. It provides a smooth inhale with vivid flavour and discreet vapour. Produced by Vapouriz Labs in the UK, the Vapouriz 50/50 range includes a diverse selection of e-liquids designed to suit every kind of vaper, from those seeking simple fruit flavours to more complex profiles. With its even balance of Vegetable Glycerine and Propylene Glycol, this 50/50 e-liquid offers a dependable vape with smooth performance and broad device compatibility.
